This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Android Developer (Kotlin) based in Romania.
 Join a remote, international team as a Senior Android Developer, building and enhancing native Android applications with a strong focus on accessibility and inclusive design. You will leverage Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Android Views to deliver reliable, high-performing mobile experiences. Your work will help ensure that applications are intuitive and accessible to users with diverse needs and abilities. You will play a key role in implementing accessibility features, improving navigation, and optimising interactions with assistive technologies such as TalkBack. Working at the intersection of mobile engineering and accessibility, you will contribute to quality assurance and compliance with recognised accessibility standards. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact through technical expertise while contributing to long-term international projects in a fully remote environment.
 Accountabilities
 As a Senior Android Developer, you will be responsible for developing robust native Android applications while ensuring that accessibility is integrated throughout the development lifecycle. Your main responsibilities will include:
Develop and maintain native Android applications using Kotlin, implementing new features and enhancing existing functionality. 
Build and improve application components using Jetpack Compose and/or traditional Android Views. 
Ensure application stability, performance, maintainability, and high code quality. 
Implement and optimise accessibility features to deliver inclusive mobile experiences. 
Ensure compatibility with TalkBack and leverage Android Accessibility APIs and Compose Semantics. 
Configure and improve content descriptions, accessibility roles, and states to support assistive technologies. 
Manage accessibility focus and navigation to provide a consistent and intuitive user experience. 
Support scalable text, accessible font sizes, and appropriately sized touch targets. 
Conduct accessibility testing, particularly with TalkBack, to identify and resolve usability issues. 
Validate accessibility implementations against relevant standards and support compliance with WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 guidelines. 
 Requirements
 The ideal candidate is an experienced Android developer with strong Kotlin skills and substantial hands-on expertise in mobile accessibility. You should be comfortable developing native applications, identifying accessibility challenges, and delivering practical solutions that improve the user experience. The following qualifications and skills are required:
At least 5 years of professional experience in native Android development. 
Strong practical knowledge of Kotlin. 
Commercial experience with Jetpack Compose and/or Android Views. 
Extensive hands-on experience implementing accessibility features in native Android applications. 
Strong practical experience using TalkBack. 
Experience with Android Accessibility APIs and/or Compose Semantics. 
Proven experience implementing content descriptions, accessibility roles and states, and accessibility focus management. 
Experience supporting scalable text, accessible font sizes, optimised touch targets, and accessible navigation. 
Practical experience conducting accessibility testing, particularly with TalkBack. 
Knowledge of accessibility standards, ideally including WCAG 2.1 and WCAG 2.2. 
Good English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international team. 
 Benefits
Fully remote work model, offering flexibility in your work environment. 
Competitive salary. 
Opportunity to work in a multinational environment on international projects. 
Comprehensive healthcare coverage. 
Long-term business-to-business (B2B) contract. 
Stable pipeline of projects, providing opportunities for continued collaboration and professional development.
